### The Way Forward - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-way-forward-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-9.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 1:20-21
Points:
- Forgetting God's past faithfulness leads to repeating cycles of fear and wasted time.
- The Israelites magnified their obstacles and enemies while failing to see God's power.
- Human temperament and natural caution must yield to confidence in who God is.
- Moving forward requires a deliberate daily choice to trust God's promises rather than retreat.

### The Burden of Inadequacy
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/the-burden-of-inadequacy
Passage: Deuteronomy 1:19-36
Points:
- Experiencing feelings of personal inadequacy is common when confronting large challenges.
- Comparing personal limitations to giant obstacles breeds fear and expectation of failure.
- Retreating from God's calling in search of safety results in spiritual bondage.
- Believers must rely on God's character and promises to receive His strength for the assignment.
